name: system
description: text-cli platform self-management directives, excluded from package install/uninstall lifecycle
description_zh: text-cli 平台自管理指令，不参与包安装/卸载生命周期

directives.description: Discover all available directives at runtime
directives.description_zh: 动态发现当前运行时全部可用指令

directives.description: Install an instruction package from local registry
directives.description_zh: 安装指令包（从本地 text-cliV1/ 注册源）

directives.description: Uninstall an instruction package (pip deps retained)
directives.description_zh: 卸载指令包（不自动清理 pip 依赖）

directives.usage_zh: 文本指令;路径,<路径文件>[,<初始输入>]
directives.description: Execute a declarative path (toolchain mode only for now)
directives.description_zh: 执行声明式路径（当前仅支持 toolchain 模式）
directives.params_desc: Path JSON file path, optional initial input

directives.description: Live-config gate: get/post a package's config via its runtime_config hook (disabled by default, independent token, runtime-local)
directives.description_zh: 配置热更新闸门：经包 runtime_config 钩子 get/post 包配置（默认关闭、独立 token、仅对实现钩子的包生效）
directives.params_desc: live-config token; action get/post; installed package id; JSON payload (post only). Common output keys: status/pkg/action/config/reason
